description: This file defines a final class `SudoStreamPids` which represents a command for starting a stream of persistence IDs with their latest snapshot revisions. The class provides methods for creation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and managing stream parameters such as burst size, timeout, and lower bounds. It includes nested classes and interfaces related to entity id handling and command categorization.
